# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Organization — Overview

> 9 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Organization under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [API Keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/api_keys.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [External Keys](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/external_keys.md): Create an external key config owned by the caller's organization.
- [Federation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/federation.md): Register an OIDC issuer that Anthropic will trust for workload identity federation in your organization.
- [Get Current Organization](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/retrieve.md): Retrieve information about the organization associated with the authenticated API key.
- [Invites](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/invites.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Rate Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/rate_limits.md): List Messages API rate limits for your organization.
- [Service Accounts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/service_accounts.md): Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409.
- [Users](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/users.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
